rules: Place exactly one queen in every row.
Place exactly one queen in every column.
Place exactly one queen in every lettered region.
Two queens must not touch, including diagonally adjacent cells.
Long diagonals are allowed: this is regional Queens, not chess N-Queens.
There is exactly one complete solution. Rows and columns are numbered from 1.
state.candidate_help: Every option already has one queen per row and column and no touching queens. Exactly one option also has one queen in each region. Select that complete solution.

pick.instructions: Select the single complete placement that satisfies ALL target board rules. Exactly one of the 12 candidates is correct. Evaluate the target board, not any example board.
